record.title: Unraveling the impact of VHL Exon 2 mutations identified in Erythrocytosis or von Hippel-Lindau disease, identified hnRNP F and hnRNP AB as new RNA-Binding Proteins involved in VHL splicing.
record.description: This study explores the impact of mutations in the exon 2 of the von Hippel-Lindau (VHL) gene, associated with erythrocytosis or von Hippel-Lindau disease. We analyzed 15 genetic variants, including missense and synonymous mutations, to assess their effects on VHL protein stability and splicing. record.title: Insights from multi-omic modelling of neurodegeneration in Xeroderma Pigmentosum using an induced pluripotent stem cell system
record.description: Xeroderma pigmentosum (XP) is caused by defective nucleotide excision-repair of DNA damage. This results in hypersensitivity to ultraviolet light and increased skin cancer risk, as sunlight-induced photoproducts remain unrepaired. However, many XP patients also display early-onset neurodegeneration, which leads to premature death. The mechanism of neurodegeneration is unknown.
